definitions.explanation: Immature soybeans harvested while still green, typically boiled or steamed in their pods and served as a snack or side dish.

examples.japanese: {枝豆|えだまめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧。
⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{枝豆|えだまめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{枝豆|えだまめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: It's customary to order edamame first at an izakaya.

notes:
Immature soybeans (⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧) picked while still in the green pod. The name literally means 'branch beans' (⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧ branch + ⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧ bean) because they were traditionally sold still attached to the branch.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枝豆|えだまめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧: to boil edamame
- ⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧{枝豆|えだまめ}: frozen edamame
- {塩|しお}ゆで{枝豆|えだまめ}: salt-boiled edamame

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the most iconic beer snacks (⟦おつまみ→おつまみ：14928_otsumami⟧) in Japan. At ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧ (Japanese pubs), edamame is often the first thing ordered and may arrive automatically as a table charge item (⟦お{通|とお}し→お通し：09728_otooshi⟧). Rich in protein and considered a healthy snack.
